shown.message:
I made two changes to the appendix paragraph on the true-curvature arm and pushed them to `dev` and `candidate-draft-8`, following `idea-repo`'s note on #21. My local build keeps the main text to 9 pages, with References on page 10 and no undefined references. I have not checked the official `document` build.

- **Lean arm removed:** the curvature estimate with its noise level subtracted is no longer quoted. `idea-repo` says subtracting the noise-only column also removes signal. The text now describes the infeasible arms as using the truth or the treatment part alone of the same draw.
- **Mechanisms (b) and (e):** the appendix now says no curvature bound reaches 0.90 there with the true curvature. The cubic estimate reaches it (0.966) only at 6.7 times the oracle width, through noise.
- **Noise-free cubic:** the appendix now also gives the width at which the noise-free cubic reaches 0.90 on the smooth block cells: κ=0.5, 1.2 times the oracle width.

The main text did not mention the lean arm, so Section 5.4 is unchanged.

Still open:
- `gnn_cells.csv` has not arrived.
- I haven't opened the `main`→`release` pull request. I'll open it when `gnn_cells.csv` is in, or once it is clear it won't land.
